# TrendNearby - Hyperlocal Social Network App

> TrendNearby is the ultimate real-time hyperlocal social network app designed to connect you instantly with events, trending posts, neighborhood conversations, and local businesses around your current location.

## Key Information
- **Platform:** Android (APK Download)
- **Status:** Available for download (v1.0.4)
- **Cost:** 100% Free
- **Privacy:** Privacy-first architecture with end-to-end data protection.

## Core Features
- **Real-Time Neighborhood Feeds:** Discover what's happening around you instantly.
- **Interactive Map Chats:** Securely chat with people and groups based on location.
- **Local Business Promotions:** Local shops can pin their business and broadcast flash sales within a 5-mile radius.

## Download Instructions
You can download the free Android APK directly from `https://trendnearby.com/trendnearby.apk`. Ensure you enable "Install from Unknown Sources" in your Android settings to install it.

## Contact & Support
- **Publisher:** TrendNearby Inc.
- **Documentation/FAQ:** See the `#faq` section on the homepage.
